title: 00134 - P053F/001343
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Fault code will typically set when the difference between Actual and Specified Rail pressure is 15-Bar or 1.50-MPa
Poor fuel quantity delivery (In tank pump, fuel filter, damaged fuel lines, etc).
Fault with the G247-Rail Fuel Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri, wiring, connections, etc.
Fault with the N276-Fuel Pressure Regulator Valve, power, ground, connections, etc.
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  the in-tank fuel pressure with a mechanical gauge during startup.
Kontrol edin:  the Advanced Measuring Values for Rail pressures
Kontrol edin:  power supply at the N276-Fuel Pressure Regulator Valve
Kontrol edin:  the G247-Rail Fuel Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri
technicalNotes:
ECM may also have stored in memory, P0088 - Yakıt Rayı / Basınç Hattı: Çok Yüksek (Aşırı Basınç).
With the 1.8L/2.0L engines, if fault code P0016 - Bank 1: Eksantrik Konum Sensörü Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G40)/Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28): Incorrect Correlation is also stored, please use this Ross-Tech forum page to verify engine timing is correct.
